description: Switches your traffic from LAN to Wi-Fi when the wired connection stops working or gets poor, and back when it recovers.
notes: LAN Wi-Fi Manager needs administrator rights to change the network priority.
It starts without them and shows a UAC prompt when you open it. Start it with 'lanwifimanager'.
The app adds its own 'LAN Wi-Fi Manager' Start menu shortcut the first time it runs (you can turn that off in its settings).
Settings and logs are kept in %AppData%\LanWifiManager, so they survive updates and uninstall.
Update with 'scoop update lan-wifi-manager' (quit the app first). Installed through Scoop, the app's own update check only tells you a new version is out and copies this command.

'scoop uninstall' does not remove the app's own Start menu shortcut or its 'LanWifiManager' start-at-login task. Before uninstalling, turn off 'Show in the Start menu and Windows search' and 'Start with Windows' in the app's settings.
